sources.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single original painted game sprite for Caelum Argenteum, a dark-fantasy RPG set in late nineteenth-century Argentina. Subject: one modest late-1800s freestanding oval cast-iron bathtub with four small dark iron claw feet, an aged ivory enamel interior, charcoal-gray exterior, a thick rolled rim, visible deep empty bowl, and a short pair of tarnished brass taps at the narrow rear end. No plumbing wall, no floor, no person, no extra props. Full object isolated on a genuinely transparent background. Three-quarter view from slightly above, showing the opening and both the front and side. Entire tub including feet and taps fits comfortably inside the image. Painted, pixel-oriented game artwork: deliberate opaque color clusters, restrained warm earth and gray palette, soft consistent upper-left lighting, clearly drawn silhouette and material shading, recognizable after reduction to a 128px inventory/world sprite. It must look like a hand-painted sprite, not a photoreal photograph, not a glossy 3D render, not vector icons. No comic outlines, text, symbols, labels or cast shadow outside the object. This is an original reconstruction of an ordinary late-Victorian sanitary fixture, not a replica of a specific museum object.

Edit target: the supplied bathtub sprite. Preserve the exact oval bathtub silhouette, four iron claw feet, two brass taps, ivory enamel inside and dark iron outside, and its three-quarter camera angle. Remove ALL background, halo, glow and outside shadow completely: every pixel outside the object must be transparent, including all spaces beneath and between the feet. The bathtub itself must be fully opaque. Repaint the object as a compact hand-painted pixel-art inventory sprite, with deliberate large stepped color clusters, simplified readable shading, a restrained 16-color earthy palette, and minimal texture noise. Aim for the visual density of a 128-pixel-wide late-1990s painted RPG sprite, enlarged with crisp edges; no photographic texture or glossy 3D-render finish. Do not add floor, wall, border, text, extra objects or cast shadow. Keep generous transparent margin around the entire object and do not crop any foot or tap.
